41|def is_interrupted_tool_result(content: Any) -> bool:
42|    """True only when the result has the executor's interrupt SHAPE: the marker is the last

44|    marker quoted inside successful output — a grep hit, a doc example — is ordinary data;
45|    this runs on every live request, so a false positive rewrites real tool output."""
